scripts.lint:openapi: spectral lint openapi/public-api.yaml --ruleset .spectral-public.yaml --fail-severity warn && spectral lint openapi/internal-callback-api.yaml --ruleset .spectral-callback.yaml --fail-severity warn && spectral lint openapi/ai-worker-internal-api.yaml --ruleset .spectral-public.yaml --fail-severity warn
scripts.codegen:java-public: openapi-generator-cli generate -g java -i openapi/public-api.yaml -o ../../apps/meeting-api/meeting-api-client/generated/public-api --additional-properties=apiPackage=com.meeting.api.client.publicapi,modelPackage=com.meeting.api.client.publicapi.model && bash scripts/cleanup-java-codegen.sh ../../apps/meeting-api/meeting-api-client/generated/public-api
scripts.codegen:java-worker-internal: openapi-generator-cli generate -g java -i openapi/ai-worker-internal-api.yaml -o ../../apps/meeting-api/meeting-api-client/generated/ai-worker-internal --additional-properties=apiPackage=com.meeting.api.client.workerinternal,modelPackage=com.meeting.api.client.workerinternal.model && bash scripts/cleanup-java-codegen.sh ../../apps/meeting-api/meeting-api-client/generated/ai-worker-internal
scripts.codegen: npm run codegen:ts && npm run codegen:py-callback && npm run codegen:py-worker-internal && npm run codegen:py-task-msg && npm run codegen:java-public && npm run codegen:java-worker-internal
